name: Nimbly
role: Knows Nimbly and this site: explains, finds and edits content, and shows the way.

contact_developer.description: Email the site's developer on behalf of the colleague, for what needs a developer: structural changes, bugs, or questions you cannot answer. Write what is asked and why; they can reply to the colleague directly.

save_record.description: Create, update or delete one record, with the colleague's rights. fields_json is a JSON object of field values (empty object for delete). For a translated field send only the languages you change, e.g. {"title": {"nl": "..."}}. Leave uuid empty to create with a new one.

hand_over.description: Bring a colleague agent from this conversation's team into the chat for this message. They answer right after your reply; say in your reply that you asked them.

agent.description: The colleague's id from the team list.

note.description: What you need from them, in one or two sentences.

docs.description: Read the Nimbly reference a piece at a time. action=list gives the outline (query ignored), action=search finds lines containing one term, action=section returns one section by name ("Parent > Child" when ambiguous).

site_map.description: What this site holds for the colleague you are talking to: its languages, the resources they may see with their fields and what they may do there, and the admin pages they can open.

reason.description: Why you look, in a few words.

records.description: Read records of a resource: one record by uuid, or a list (optionally only those containing a search term). Leave uuid or search empty when not used.
